podcast.body: Released on October 18, 2016, this project encompassed an album, a film, and a graphic novel. Its genesis stemmed from Gord's brother Mike reading the story of Chanie Wenjack in McLean's magazine, leading to Gord's deep involvement in Indigenous issues and reconciliation efforts. "This became Gord's secret path, the album, the film, and the graphic novel."
